question: A toroid with a mean radius of $15\, \text{cm}$ has $3000$ turns of wire. A current of $2.0\, \text{A}$ flows through the winding. The core of the toroid is filled with a magnetic material. If the magnetic field $B$ inside the core is found to be $5.0\, \text{T}$, calculate the approximate relative permeability $\mu_r$ of the core material. (Take $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\, \text{T}\cdot\text{m/A}$)
